onsite.intake: VP Engineering asked for help after the checkout migration stalled; qualified because it is FDE Deep Engagement and Commit at Risk.
onsite.goal: Agree a plan to move checkout personalization to Workers within 60 days
onsite.execution: Full day at customer HQ: morning design, afternoon hands-on build, exec readout at 16:00.
agenda: 09:00  Business context: checkout conversion goals and commit status
11:00  Target design: personalization logic at the edge on Workers
13:00  Hands-on build: prototype one personalization rule
16:00  Exec readout and agreed next steps
prep_checklist: Review usage telemetry and commit burn trend
Get current checkout architecture diagram from customer
Build a working demo of edge personalization
Confirm decision makers attend the exec readout
Draft success metric and 60-day plan for review
follow_ups: Send written migration plan within 48 hours
Weekly FDE build session for 6 weeks
onsite.success_metric: Personalization live on Workers for 25% of checkout traffic in 60 days; commit burn pace back above 90%

program.name: Commit Burn Sprint
program.trigger: Commit at Risk flag: 25%+ into contract and consuming less than 70% of expected pace
program.owner: Scaled SA team (pooled), with FDE escalation for top-30 accounts
program.cadence: 6-week sprint: kickoff, weekly 30-min office hours, week-6 review
steps: Auto-enroll flagged accounts weekly from Salesforce
Diagnose: find the stalled workload from usage data
Kickoff call: agree one workload to move in 6 weeks
Weekly office hours + reusable migration templates
Week 6: review burn pace; exit or escalate to FDE/PS offer
program.success_metric: 60% of enrolled accounts back above 90% burn pace within 90 days

handoff.owner: Scaled SA team lead owns the program; GTM Strategy keeps the measurement.
ready_when: Holdout comparison shows lift for two cycles in a row
Playbook, templates and enrollment are documented and automated
Owner has the headcount and a quarterly review on the calendar
